page_title: BHA 1-0 NOT | Brighton v Nottingham Forest 10/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Michael Salisbury has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Adam Lallana (Brighton) is given a yellow card.
90+5' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) has tested the patience of referee Michael Salisbury and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+4' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the corner with a short pass.
90+4' Pascal Gross (Brighton) works the corner short.
90+3' Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham) tackles a bit over-zealously and Michael Salisbury blows for a foul.
90+2' The linesman raises his flag. Adam Lallana (Brighton) is adjudged offside.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.

90' A fine move culminates with a precision cross onto the head of Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham) in the centre of the box. It's a good attempt but goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
90' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Michael Salisbury signals.
89' Brighton keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
87' The substitution is prepared. Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Morgan Gibbs-White.

87' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Julio Enciso (Brighton), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
86' Nottingham string together a series of short passes.
82' Pascal Gross (Brighton) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
80' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Adam Lallana (Brighton) replacing Simon Adingra.
80' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Bart Verbruggen.
78' Booking. Joel Veltman (Brighton) receives a caution from the referee.
78' Brighton are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
76' It will be a substitution. Julio Enciso (Brighton) is ready to enter the pitch as Jakub Moder walks off.
76' The referee signals a substitution. Igor (Brighton) is brought on as a substitute for Pervis Estupinan.
74' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
72' Nuno Espirito Santo prepares a substitution. Ryan Yates is replaced by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham).
72' Substitution. Nicolas Dominguez will be replaced by Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham).
71' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nottingham comes to nothing.

71' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Chris Wood (Nottingham) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Bart Verbruggen was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play. Nottingham are awarded a corner kick.
69' Here comes the VAR decision. Referee Michael Salisbury produces a yellow card from his pocket and Jakub Moder (Brighton) looks mighty relieved!

68' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Jakub Moder (Brighton), but referee Michael Salisbury must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
65' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
64' The Brighton players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
61' Here is a change. Ansu Fati is going off and Roberto De Zerbi gives the last tactical orders to Tariq Lamptey (Brighton).
60' It's time for a substitution. Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) comes on in place of Danilo.
60' Evan Ferguson comes off the pitch to be replaced by Danny Welbeck (Brighton).
60' Substitution. Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) on for Divock Origi.
59' Ansu Fati (Brighton) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Michael Salisbury saw the whole situation.
56' Nottingham are seeing far more of the ball now.
55' Neco Williams (Nottingham) picks up a yellow card.
51' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

48' Ambitious effort from Divock Origi (Nottingham). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Nottingham are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' The game is interrupted now, Lewis Dunk (Brighton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
42' Nottingham hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
41' Ansu Fati (Brighton) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
38' Ansu Fati (Brighton) commits a rough challenge and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for a foul.

38' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
35' Some patient build-up play from Nottingham as they look to unlock the defence.
32' The corner from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is cleared away by the defence.

31' Divock Origi (Nottingham) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Bart Verbruggen anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
30' 1 - 0 What an unlucky own goal by Andrew Omobamidele (Nottingham)!
28' Andrew Omobamidele (Nottingham) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for an infringement.
24' Michael Salisbury couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) and blew his whistle.
22' Ansu Fati (Brighton) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
20' Brighton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
20' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) trips an opposition player and Michael Salisbury signals a foul.
19' Yellow card. Andrew Omobamidele (Nottingham) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
16' The corner is swung in but Brighton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
15' Brighton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
15' Jakub Moder (Brighton) latches onto a precise lofted pass into the penalty area and produces a header at goal, but his attempt under the bar fails to beat Matz Sels, who makes a sensational save.
14' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
13' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) makes a strong challenge and Michael Salisbury blows for a foul.

11' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the left post by a whisker. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
10' Simon Adingra (Brighton) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Matz Sels.
9' Michael Salisbury blows his whistle after Chris Wood (Nottingham) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
9' The Brighton players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
5' Neco Williams (Nottingham) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

4' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Michael Salisbury blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Nottingham are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
3' Brighton players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Nottingham will kick the game off.
Michael Salisbury will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
Show lineups
